evidence.quote: Today, I will share my views on evolving financial technology and the importance of ongoing, responsible innovation, including the roles of both the public and private sectors in shaping the future.
As a second principle, regulatory openness is a critical ingredient to fostering innovation in the financial system.
Policymakers should strive to define a clear and sensible regulatory framework designed to meet policy objectives that also enables the private sector to innovate within the established guardrails.
